market.what: Li-S battery cells sold (drones, satellites, defense), world; binder slice is <1% of this
market.method: Grand View $90M; SNS $59M, Prophecy $67M agree; check: ~0.1 GWh shipped (Lyten pilot lines up to 0.2 GWh/yr) x ~$900/kWh est.
market.job_what: binder + separator materials in Li-S cells sold, world
market.job_method: ~$90M Li-S cells x ~7% (binder ~1.3% + separator ~6% of cell cost, Li-ion analog) = ~$6.5M; low confidence

value.logic: est. 2032 Li-S ~15 GWh/yr (Lyten Reno 10 GWh + others); shuttle fix doubles cycle life (today ~300 at 100% DOD) -> halves $/kWh-cycle: 15 GWh x ~$75/kWh saved
value.revenue_logic: 15 GWh x ~30 g binder/kWh = 450 t x $50/kg (est., ~5x cathode PVDF) = $22M pool x 40-45% share
value.margin_logic: specialty functional binder, small tonnage, few buyers; urea/thiourea chemistry from cheap amines

trend.drivers: drones and defense needing non-China cells; light, Ni/Co-free cells for HAPS, eVTOL, later EV
trend.deadline: FY24 NDAA Sec. 154: DoD cannot buy CATL/BYD/EVE/Gotion batteries from 1 Oct 2027

competition.notes: Lyten strongest: +$200M in 2025, >$625M total, bought Northvolt Poland/Sweden; Theion EUR15M (Mar 2025); Gelion GBP10M (Oct 2025); Li-S Energy A$7.9M ARENA

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: tren + aryl iso(thio)cyanates with quaternary ammonium arm; 3 variants, 5-20 g each
lab.test: Li2S6 adsorption (UV-vis) + Li-S coin cells, S loading >=4 mg/cm2, 200+ cycles at C/5-C/2; university battery lab or RIT/OSU battery centers
lab.logic: synth 5 wk + adsorption 1 wk + cycling 6 wk; synth 3 x ~$5k = $15k + cells/channels (~$200/channel/month) and SEM/XPS ~$15k

sale.gates: cell-maker sample eval 6-12 mo; pouch-cell validation; TSCA/REACH notice for new substance; first orders kg-scale for pilot lines
